summary: Creates a DAT-driven grid of panel gadgets where each cell's value, state, and appearance are described by cell, row, column, and table attribute DATs.

key_params.name: attributes
key_params.note: Cell Attributes DAT list, one entry per cell

key_params.name: rowattributes
key_params.note: Row Attributes DAT list, one entry per row

key_params.name: colattributes
key_params.note: Column Attributes DAT list, one entry per column

key_params.name: values
key_params.note: Cell contents for cells whose attribute type is field

key_params.name: tablealign
key_params.note: Horizontal or vertical ordering of cells

key_params.name: fontsizeunit
key_params.note: Interprets font sizes as pixels or points

key_params.name: infoformat
key_params.note: Info DAT state output as a column or grid

key_params.name: tableoffset
key_params.note: Draw offset for the table inside the component

key_params.name: tablereset
key_params.note: Refreshes the Table COMP after definition DAT changes

key_concepts: cell, row, column, and table attribute precedence
cell states: default, rollover, select, selectrollover
Value Tables for editable field contents
Table Reset after definition DAT changes
common_gotchas: Table COMP cells are defined by DAT tables; it is not a general spreadsheet editor by itself.
Attribute lookup falls through cell, row, column, and table attribute DATs, so broad table defaults can be overridden at several levels.
Cell state affects the second-level lookup; account for default, rollover, select, and selectrollover states.
Value tables need one row per cell; reshape multi-column data before wiring it as values.
Input 0 expects a Table DAT with rows used as Table COMP cell content.
Do not drive font selection with both fontpath and font attributes at the same time.
Table Offset moves the drawn table, not the COMP panel itself, and can interact with child cropping.
Use Table Reset after changing definition DATs if the panel does not visually refresh.
